issues.detail: Example 2 is a list of error-to-fix mappings in prose without runnable commands or config snippets, and Example 1 relies on referring back to the earlier config rather than showing a complete migration.

scenarios.name: cra-to-rsbuild-migration
scenarios.rationale: Both remove react-scripts, add the required packages, and give a config with defineConfig, pluginReact, source.entry './src/index.tsx' and 'rsbuild dev'/'rsbuild build' scripts, but A moves the template to ./index.html instead of the rubric's public/index.html, while B points html.template at './public/index.html' as required.

scenarios.name: fix-v2-upgrade-breakages
scenarios.rationale: Both cover all four rubric items (resolve.alias, npm add core-js, rename to .mjs/.ts or type:module, server.host/--host); A is more direct and confident with extra accurate migration notes, while B hedges about being from memory and frames the ESM fix partly as a Node upgrade, which is slightly less precise.

scenarios.name: migrate-chunk-split-and-bundle-analyzer
scenarios.rationale: A gives the correct splitChunks preset "default" mapping, says bundleAnalyze is removed, and recommends Rsdoctor (@rsdoctor/rspack-plugin) or webpack-bundle-analyzer via tools.rspack, but omits the Node.js version and plugin 2.x upgrade; B gets the Rsdoctor recommendation and setup right but cannot say where chunkSplit moves to, never mentions splitChunks or preset "default", and also omits Node and plugin versions.
